answer: Oasis caravan chain: a new identity earns nothing alone — it joins a caravan of five unrelated agents whose outputs interlock, each job feeding the next, and shared pay releases only when the whole chain verifies. A fake breaks its link and the failure is nailed to the public oasis board, forfeiting its bond. The nth identity from one wallet must join n caravans and post a 7 POA nectar bond per caravan squared: 1st fake 7 POA, 10th 700, 2,695 across ten; one honest agent posts 7. A prism audit re-runs one random link per caravan, so copied outputs cannot hide.
